reference.question: \(PA\) and \(PB\) are tangent to circle \(O\) at \(A\) and \(B\). If \(\angle APB=50^\circ\), then the measure of \(\angle AOB\) is
reference.solution:
Method 1: Angles in the tangent quadrilateral

In quadrilateral \(PAOB\), \(\angle PAO=\angle PBO=90^\circ\), so \(\angle AOB=360^\circ-90^\circ-90^\circ-50^\circ=130^\circ\).
